guidance.brief: Pin a conversation worth coming back to: `tower x pins pin --note '<why>'`; `tower x pins list` lists every pin with its session id.
guidance.full: A pin keeps a worker in the sidebar's Pinned section, after it goes home too, so the user finds the conversation months later. Pin yourself when the user asks you to, or when the conversation made something they will want to come back to and asked for that: `tower x pins pin --note 'made the pricing page'` (a few words on why; pinning again replaces the note). `--session <id>` pins another worker. `tower x pins unpin` unpins you, or `--session <id>` another. `tower x pins list` lists every pin on every floor with its callsign, floor and session id: `tower agent <session>` then reads that worker. Don't pin as a matter of course: a pin is a bookmark the user reads.
